_instructions: The EPAY Payment Portal page. NOTE: written from the online-invoicing and portal material already in the site — Matt has not yet supplied a full description of the portal, so this is deliberately thin. Ask him for: what a merchant can actually do in the portal, whether it is the same thing as portal.epaypos.net, and whether it is included or priced separately.
heading: EPAY Payment Portal
lede: Take payment when the customer isn't standing in front of you. Send a link, get paid, and have it land in the same reporting as everything else.
_needs_from_matt: What can a merchant do in the portal that they can't do at the register?
Is this the same system as portal.epaypos.net, or separate?
Included with a plan, or priced on its own?

features.name: Online Invoicing
features.body: Send a payment link and get paid without the customer in front of you.

features.name: Every Payment Type
features.body: EMV chip, tap, swipe, mobile wallets and gift cards, the same as the register.

features.name: Next-Day Funding
features.body: Batches settle to your bank account the next business day.

features.name: One Set of Reporting
features.body: Portal payments show up beside counter sales, not in a separate system.
